name: Boundary Probe
summary: Not a useful module: deliberately misbehaves at the wasm host boundary to show how ModuleHost::run and execute_command answer each failure shape.
description: Every command here is a distinct way a module can fail once it is already running: a response that isn't JSON, JSON of the wrong shape, both `output` and `error` set at once, a bare `null`, a run that writes nothing at all, a deliberate `unreachable` trap, a deliberate out-of-bounds memory access, and a cheap infinite loop under a fuel budget set near the manifest ceiling with a short wall clock, to show the wall-clock deadline firing before fuel would. None of this is useful output - it exists so the exact wording of each `{ "ok": false, "error": ... }` this deployment answers with is visible from a live install, not just from reading the host's source.
author: slim-m

permissions.name: Run boundary probes
permissions.description: Run this module's deliberately-misbehaving commands in this space.

extension_points.name: malformed-not-json
extension_points.description: Answers with bytes that are not JSON at all.

extension_points.name: malformed-wrong-shape
extension_points.description: Answers with valid JSON that is not the {ok, output/error} object the ABI expects.

extension_points.name: malformed-both-fields
extension_points.description: Answers ok:true with both output and error set.

extension_points.name: malformed-null
extension_points.description: Answers with the JSON literal null.

extension_points.name: no-output
extension_points.description: run() returns a zero-length response region.

extension_points.name: trap-out-of-bounds
extension_points.description: Deliberately reads memory far past this module's own linear memory.

extension_points.name: loop-forever
extension_points.description: An unconditional loop. This manifest's fuel is set near the host's own ceiling with a short wall clock, so the wall clock - not fuel - is what stops it.
